articles.title: A Morning Coffee Run
articles.summaryCN: 一个忙碌清晨的咖啡外带小故事，练点单、尺寸和口味。

sentences.text: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.meaningCN: 大家早上好。

sentences.text: I am in a hurry, so I just want a coffee to go.
sentences.meaningCN: 我赶时间，所以只想要一杯咖啡带走。

sentences.text: The cafe is next to the station, and it is already busy.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡店在车站旁边，已经忙起来了。

sentences.text: I feel hungry, so I order a muffin as well.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得饿了，所以又点了一个松饼。

sentences.text: The barista smiles and asks what size I want.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡师笑着问我要什么尺寸。

sentences.text: I ask for a medium with milk, but no sugar.
sentences.meaningCN: 我要中杯、加奶、不加糖。

sentences.text: She asks if I want oat milk today.
sentences.meaningCN: 她问我今天要不要燕麦奶。

sentences.text: I say yes, and I ask for an extra shot.
sentences.meaningCN: 我说好，还要一份额外的浓缩。

sentences.text: "That will be five dollars," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说：“一共五美元。”

sentences.text: I pay by card and wait near the counter.
sentences.meaningCN: 我刷卡付款，在柜台旁等候。

sentences.text: The machine is loud, and the room smells wonderful.
sentences.meaningCN: 机器很响，屋里香气扑鼻。

sentences.text: A man beside me is reading a newspaper.
sentences.meaningCN: 我旁边的男人在看报纸。

sentences.text: A student is typing quickly on her laptop.
sentences.meaningCN: 一个学生在笔记本电脑上飞快打字。

sentences.text: Everyone seems calm except me.
sentences.meaningCN: 除了我，大家似乎都很从容。

sentences.text: I check my phone and see that I am late.
sentences.meaningCN: 我看了一眼手机，发现已经迟了。

sentences.text: The barista calls my name and hands me the cup.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡师叫我的名字，把杯子递给我。

sentences.text: The cup is warm in my hand.
sentences.meaningCN: 杯子在我手里暖暖的。

sentences.text: I walk out and turn left at the corner.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走出去，在街角左转。

sentences.text: The street is full of people and bicycles.
sentences.meaningCN: 街上满是行人和自行车。

sentences.text: I take a sip and the coffee tastes strong and sweet.
sentences.meaningCN: 我喝了一口，咖啡又浓又甜。

sentences.text: It is a small pleasure on a busy day.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是忙碌日子里的一点小确幸。

sentences.text: I will come back tomorrow morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天早上我还会再来。

sentences.text: Maybe I will try a latte next time.
sentences.meaningCN: 也许下次我会试试拿铁。

sentences.text: The cafe also sells fresh bread and cakes.
sentences.meaningCN: 这家店还卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。

sentences.text: The line is long, but the staff are fast.
sentences.meaningCN: 队伍很长，但店员动作很快。

sentences.text: They know many customers by name.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们能叫出许多顾客的名字。

sentences.text: An old woman is talking to the owner.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位老妇人正在和店主聊天。

sentences.text: They laugh about the rainy weather.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们笑着聊起下雨的天气。

sentences.text: I finish my coffee near the park.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在公园附近喝完咖啡。

sentences.text: The sky is still gray, but I feel awake.
sentences.meaningCN: 天空仍然灰蒙蒙的，但我清醒了。

sentences.text: I throw the cup into the bin.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把杯子扔进垃圾桶。

sentences.text: Then I walk to the office with a clear head.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后我头脑清醒地走向办公室。

sentences.text: Outside, a bus stops with a soft hiss.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面，一辆公交车伴着轻轻的嘶声停下。

sentences.text: I step onto it and find a seat by the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 我上了车，在窗边找了个座位。

sentences.text: The city passes quickly, and my mind is quiet.
sentences.meaningCN: 城市飞快掠过，我的心很安静。

sentences.text: I take the last sip near the station door.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在车站门口喝完最后一口。

sentences.text: The bus is already waiting at the stop.
sentences.meaningCN: 公交车已经在站台等着了。

sentences.text: I find a seat and open my notebook.
sentences.meaningCN: 我找了个座位，打开笔记本。

sentences.text: A new day has begun.
sentences.meaningCN: 新的一天开始了。

articles.title: Dinner for Two
articles.summaryCN: 两人晚餐：订位、前菜、主菜、账单与分摊。

sentences.text: On Friday night, I want to book a table for two.
sentences.meaningCN: 周五晚上，我想订一张两人桌。

sentences.text: The restaurant is small, warm, and close to the river.
sentences.meaningCN: 餐厅不大，很温暖，离河很近。

sentences.text: We arrive at seven and the waiter greets us at the door.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们七点到，服务员在门口迎接。

sentences.text: He takes our coats and shows us to a quiet table.
sentences.meaningCN: 他接过我们的外套，把我们带到一张安静的桌子。

sentences.text: The menu has many dishes, and everything sounds good.
sentences.meaningCN: 菜单上菜很多，每道听起来都不错。

sentences.text: We order still water while we read.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们边看边点了still water。

sentences.text: My friend asks for a vegetarian option.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友问有没有素食选项。

sentences.text: The waiter says the soup is vegetarian today.
sentences.meaningCN: 服务员说今天的汤是素的。

sentences.text: We share a starter with bread and tomatoes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们分了一份配面包和番茄的前菜。

sentences.text: The starter is simple but very fresh.
sentences.meaningCN: 前菜简单，但非常新鲜。

sentences.text: For the main course, I choose fish with rice.
sentences.meaningCN: 主菜我选了鱼配米饭。

sentences.text: My friend orders pasta with mushrooms.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友点了蘑菇意面。

sentences.text: The food arrives after fifteen minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 食物十五分钟后到了。

sentences.text: The fish is soft, and the sauce is light.
sentences.meaningCN: 鱼肉很嫩，酱汁清淡。

sentences.text: We talk about work, travel, and old friends.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们聊工作、旅行和老朋友。

sentences.text: The waiter fills our glasses and smiles.
sentences.meaningCN: 服务员给我们倒满水，笑了笑。

sentences.text: For dessert, we share a small chocolate cake.
sentences.meaningCN: 甜点我们分了一块小巧克力蛋糕。

sentences.text: The cake is sweet, but not too heavy.
sentences.meaningCN: 蛋糕很甜，但不腻。

sentences.text: We drink tea and watch the lights on the river.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们喝茶，看河上的灯光。

sentences.text: The restaurant becomes quieter after nine.
sentences.meaningCN: 九点后餐厅安静下来。

sentences.text: We ask for the bill and the waiter brings it quickly.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们叫结账，服务员很快拿来账单。

sentences.text: We decide to split the bill.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们决定分摊账单。

sentences.text: I pay my part by card, and my friend pays cash.
sentences.meaningCN: 我刷卡付自己那份，朋友付现金。

sentences.text: We leave a small tip on the table.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们在桌上留了一点小费。

sentences.text: The waiter thanks us and opens the door.
sentences.meaningCN: 服务员道谢并为我们开门。

sentences.text: Outside, the night air is cool and clean.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面，夜晚的空气清凉干净。

sentences.text: We walk along the river for a while.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们沿着河走了一会儿。

sentences.text: It is a good end to a long week.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是一周辛苦工作的好结尾。

sentences.text: The river is dark, and the city lights move on the water.
sentences.meaningCN: 河水很深，城市灯光在水面晃动。

sentences.text: We talk about coming back next month.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们聊到下个月再来。

sentences.text: My friend says she knows a good place for dessert.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友说她知道一家不错的甜点店。

sentences.text: I laugh and say we already had cake.
sentences.meaningCN: 我笑着说我们已经吃过蛋糕了。

sentences.text: It is late, so we call a taxi.
sentences.meaningCN: 时间不早了，我们叫了出租车。

sentences.text: We say goodbye and promise to meet again.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们道别，约好再见面。

sentences.text: The taxi is warm, and the driver plays soft music.
sentences.meaningCN: 出租车里很暖，司机放着轻柔的音乐。

sentences.text: I look at the river one last time.
sentences.meaningCN: 我最后看了一眼河。

sentences.text: It was a simple dinner, but I will remember it.
sentences.meaningCN: 这顿晚餐很简单，但我会记住它。

articles.title: Takeaway on a Busy Night
articles.summaryCN: 忙碌夜晚的外带订单：点餐、总价、现金与退单。

sentences.text: It is late, and I am too tired to cook.
sentences.meaningCN: 已经很晚了，我累得不想做饭。

sentences.text: I decide to order food from a small shop near my home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我决定从家附近的小店点餐。

sentences.text: The shop is busy, so I use the app instead of calling.
sentences.meaningCN: 店里很忙，所以我用应用下单，没有打电话。

sentences.text: I want a hot soup, a sandwich, and a drink.
sentences.meaningCN: 我想要热汤、三明治和饮料。

sentences.text: The app asks if I want to get takeaway or eat in.
sentences.meaningCN: 应用问我是外带还是堂食。

sentences.text: I choose takeaway because I want to go home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我选外带，因为我想回家。

sentences.text: I add extra napkins to the order.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在订单里加了额外的餐巾纸。

sentences.text: I also ask for no ice in my drink.
sentences.meaningCN: 我还要求饮料不加冰。

sentences.text: The total is twenty dollars.
sentences.meaningCN: 总价是二十美元。

sentences.text: I notice the shop takes cash only.
sentences.meaningCN: 我注意到这家店只收现金。

sentences.text: I check my wallet and find enough cash.
sentences.meaningCN: 我检查钱包，发现现金够用。

sentences.text: I walk to the shop in the light rain.
sentences.meaningCN: 我冒着小雨走向店里。

sentences.text: The street is quiet, and most shops are closed.
sentences.meaningCN: 街上很安静，大多数店都关门了。

sentences.text: A delivery rider passes me on a bike.
sentences.meaningCN: 一个外卖骑手骑车从我身边经过。

sentences.text: At the shop, a young man is packing bags.
sentences.meaningCN: 店里，一个年轻人在打包。

sentences.text: He tells me my food will be ready soon.
sentences.meaningCN: 他告诉我食物很快就好。

sentences.text: I wait by the window and watch the rain.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在窗边等，看着雨。

sentences.text: The man calls my number and gives me the bag.
sentences.meaningCN: 他叫我的号，把袋子递给我。

sentences.text: I ask for a refund for the drink because it is wrong.
sentences.meaningCN: 饮料做错了，我要求退款。

sentences.text: He checks the order and gives me the money.
sentences.meaningCN: 他核对了订单，把钱退给我。

sentences.text: He also gives me a snack for free.
sentences.meaningCN: 他还免费送了我一份小吃。

sentences.text: I take a bite while I wait for the bus.
sentences.meaningCN: 等公交时我咬了一口。

sentences.text: The soup is hot, and the sandwich is fresh.
sentences.meaningCN: 汤很热，三明治很新鲜。

sentences.text: I feel full and happy on the way home.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家路上我吃得饱饱的，很开心。

sentences.text: At home, I put the food on the table.
sentences.meaningCN: 到家后，我把食物放在桌上。

sentences.text: I eat slowly and listen to music.
sentences.meaningCN: 我慢慢吃，听着音乐。

sentences.text: Next time, I will check the order before I leave.
sentences.meaningCN: 下次离开前我会先检查订单。

sentences.text: It is a small mistake, but the shop fixes it well.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是个小失误，但店里处理得很好。

sentences.text: I put the empty boxes in the bin.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把空盒子扔进垃圾桶。

sentences.text: Then I wash my hands and make some tea.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后洗手泡了杯茶。

sentences.text: The rain is still falling outside.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面雨还在下。

sentences.text: I open a book but fall asleep on the sofa.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打开书，却在沙发上睡着了。

sentences.text: It was a busy night, but everything worked out.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是个忙碌的夜晚，但一切都解决了。

sentences.text: I turn off the lamp and go to bed.
sentences.meaningCN: 我关灯上床。

sentences.text: The rain stops before midnight.
sentences.meaningCN: 雨在午夜前停了。

sentences.text: Tomorrow I will cook something simple.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天我要做点简单的饭菜。

sentences.text: For now, I just want to sleep.
sentences.meaningCN: 现在，我只想睡觉。

articles.title: Checking In at the Airport
articles.summaryCN: 机场值机：托运行李、登机牌、座位与登机口。

sentences.text: My flight leaves at nine, so I arrive at the airport at seven.
sentences.meaningCN: 航班九点起飞，所以我七点就到了机场。

sentences.text: The airport is busy, but the signs are clear.
sentences.meaningCN: 机场很忙，但指示牌很清楚。

sentences.text: I need to check in for my flight to London.
sentences.meaningCN: 我需要办理去伦敦的航班值机。

sentences.text: I walk to the counter and show my passport.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走到柜台，出示护照。

sentences.text: The woman asks if I want a window seat.
sentences.meaningCN: 工作人员问我要不要靠窗座位。

sentences.text: I say yes, and she prints my boarding pass.
sentences.meaningCN: 我说要，她打印了我的登机牌。

sentences.text: My friend prefers an aisle seat.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友更喜欢靠过道的座位。

sentences.text: She books it for him without any trouble.
sentences.meaningCN: 她顺利地为朋友订好了。

sentences.text: The woman tells me the gate number.
sentences.meaningCN: 她告诉我登机口号码。

sentences.text: I ask where is the security check.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问安检在哪里。

sentences.text: She says go straight and turn right at the coffee shop.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说一直走，在咖啡店右转。

sentences.text: I follow her direction and join the line.
sentences.meaningCN: 我按她说的走，加入了队伍。

sentences.text: The line moves faster than I expect.
sentences.meaningCN: 队伍比我想象的快。

sentences.text: I put my bag on the belt and walk through.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把包放上传送带，走了过去。

sentences.text: My flight is on time today.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的航班今天准点。

sentences.text: I find a seat near the gate and check my email.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在登机口附近找了个座位，查看邮件。

sentences.text: A family with two children sits beside me.
sentences.meaningCN: 一家带着两个孩子的人坐在我旁边。

sentences.text: The children are excited about the trip.
sentences.meaningCN: 孩子们对旅行很兴奋。

sentences.text: I buy a bottle of water and a small snack.
sentences.meaningCN: 我买了一瓶水和一份小零食。

sentences.text: I hear an announcement about boarding.
sentences.meaningCN: 我听到登机广播。

sentences.text: I look at my boarding pass again.
sentences.meaningCN: 我又看了一眼登机牌。

sentences.text: The gate is close, so I walk slowly.
sentences.meaningCN: 登机口很近，所以我慢慢走。

sentences.text: I call my friend and tell him I am ready.
sentences.meaningCN: 我给朋友打电话，说我准备好了。

sentences.text: He says he is near the gate already.
sentences.meaningCN: 他说他已经到登机口附近了。

sentences.text: We meet at the window and watch the planes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们在窗边碰面，看着飞机。

sentences.text: The sky is bright, and the runway is long.
sentences.meaningCN: 天空明亮，跑道很长。

sentences.text: We board the plane at half past eight.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们八点半登机。

sentences.text: It is the start of a short holiday.
sentences.meaningCN: 一段短假开始了。

sentences.text: The plane pushes back from the gate.
sentences.meaningCN: 飞机从登机口推出。

sentences.text: The crew shows us how to use the life jacket.
sentences.meaningCN: 机组人员演示救生衣的用法。

sentences.text: I put my bag under the seat.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把包放在座位下面。

sentences.text: The engine is loud, and the plane begins to move.
sentences.meaningCN: 引擎很响，飞机开始移动。

sentences.text: I look out of the window as the city gets smaller.
sentences.meaningCN: 我看着窗外，城市越来越小。

sentences.text: Soon we are above the clouds.
sentences.meaningCN: 很快我们就到了云层之上。

sentences.text: I close my eyes and listen to the engines.
sentences.meaningCN: 我闭上眼睛，听着引擎声。

sentences.text: In two hours, I will be in a new city.
sentences.meaningCN: 两小时后，我就会到一座新城市。

sentences.text: I smile and think about the holiday.
sentences.meaningCN: 我微笑着，想着假期。

articles.title: Through Security to the Gate
articles.summaryCN: 安检到登机口：方向、时间、登机牌与登机组。

sentences.text: I arrive at the airport with my small bag.
sentences.meaningCN: 我带着小包到达机场。

sentences.text: The security check is at the end of the hall.
sentences.meaningCN: 安检在大厅尽头。

sentences.text: A staff member tells me to go straight.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位工作人员让我一直走。

sentences.text: Then I should turn left after the shops.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后过了商店后左转。

sentences.text: I ask what time boarding starts.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问几点开始登机。

sentences.text: He says it starts at ten fifteen.
sentences.meaningCN: 他说十点十五开始。

sentences.text: I don't understand the gate number.
sentences.meaningCN: 我没听懂登机口号码。

sentences.text: He repeats it slowly and points at the screen.
sentences.meaningCN: 他慢慢重复，并指着屏幕。

sentences.text: I thank him and walk to the line.
sentences.meaningCN: 我道谢后走向队伍。

sentences.text: The line is long, but it moves quickly.
sentences.meaningCN: 队伍很长，但移动得很快。

sentences.text: I take out my laptop and my liquids.
sentences.meaningCN: 我拿出笔记本电脑和液体。

sentences.text: A woman checks my boarding pass.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位女士检查我的登机牌。

sentences.text: She asks me to step through the scanner.
sentences.meaningCN: 她让我走过扫描仪。

sentences.text: My bag is clear, and I pick it up.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的包没问题，我把它拿起来。

sentences.text: I look for a boarding group on the screen.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在屏幕上寻找登机组。

sentences.text: The screen shows that my flight is boarding.
sentences.meaningCN: 屏幕显示我的航班正在登机。

sentences.text: I walk to the gate and find a free seat.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走到登机口，找了个空位。

sentences.text: A man is charging his phone near the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 一个男人在窗边给手机充电。

sentences.text: A child is sleeping on her mother's lap.
sentences.meaningCN: 一个孩子睡在妈妈腿上。

sentences.text: I buy a coffee and sit down.
sentences.meaningCN: 我买了杯咖啡坐下。

sentences.text: I check my passport and my ticket.
sentences.meaningCN: 我检查护照和机票。

sentences.text: The gate agent calls my group.
sentences.meaningCN: 登机口工作人员叫到我的组。

sentences.text: I stand up and join the line.
sentences.meaningCN: 我起身加入队伍。

sentences.text: The plane is ready, and the crew is smiling.
sentences.meaningCN: 飞机准备好了，机组人员在微笑。

sentences.text: I send a message to my family.
sentences.meaningCN: 我给家人发了条消息。

sentences.text: They wish me a safe flight.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们祝我一路平安。

sentences.text: I walk through the door and onto the plane.
sentences.meaningCN: 我穿过门，走上飞机。

sentences.text: The seat is small, but the window is clear.
sentences.meaningCN: 座位很小，但窗户很明亮。

sentences.text: The agent scans my boarding pass.
sentences.meaningCN: 工作人员扫描我的登机牌。

sentences.text: I walk down the bridge and into the plane.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走过廊桥，进入机舱。

sentences.text: A flight attendant greets me with a smile.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位空乘微笑着迎接我。

sentences.text: I find my seat and put my bag above.
sentences.meaningCN: 我找到座位，把包放上去。

sentences.text: The passenger beside me is reading a map.
sentences.meaningCN: 旁边的乘客在看地图。

sentences.text: I fasten my seat belt and wait.
sentences.meaningCN: 我系好安全带，等待起飞。

sentences.text: The plane is full, and the crew is busy.
sentences.meaningCN: 飞机坐满了，机组人员很忙。

sentences.text: I put on my headphones and choose some music.
sentences.meaningCN: 我戴上耳机，选了些音乐。

sentences.text: The engines start, and the plane moves slowly.
sentences.meaningCN: 引擎启动，飞机缓缓移动。

sentences.text: I am ready for the flight.
sentences.meaningCN: 我准备好起飞了。

articles.title: A Delayed Flight
articles.summaryCN: 航班延误后的转机、行李与出租车，练求助与时间表达。

sentences.text: I land at the airport and check my connecting flight.
sentences.meaningCN: 我降落机场，查看转机航班。

sentences.text: The weather is bad, and it is rainy outside.
sentences.meaningCN: 天气不好，外面在下雨。

sentences.text: I have an umbrella, but my bag is heavy.
sentences.meaningCN: 我带了伞，但包很重。

sentences.text: The screen says my next flight is delayed.
sentences.meaningCN: 屏幕显示我的下一班航班延误了。

sentences.text: I ask a staff member what I should do right now.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问工作人员现在该怎么办。

sentences.text: She says the flight will leave a bit later.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说航班会晚一点起飞。

sentences.text: I need to find baggage claim first.
sentences.meaningCN: 我得先去找行李提取处。

sentences.text: The signs are hard to read in the crowd.
sentences.meaningCN: 人群里很难看清指示牌。

sentences.text: I follow the other passengers down the stairs.
sentences.meaningCN: 我跟着其他乘客下楼。

sentences.text: A train takes us to the main building.
sentences.meaningCN: 一列小火车把我们带到主楼。

sentences.text: The station is warm and full of noise.
sentences.meaningCN: 车站很暖和，充满了嘈杂声。

sentences.text: I wait near the baggage belt for twenty minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在行李传送带旁等了二十分钟。

sentences.text: My suitcase finally appears on the belt.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的行李箱终于出现在传送带上。

sentences.text: I take a taxi stand outside the door.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在门外找到了出租车候车点。

sentences.text: The line for taxis is very long.
sentences.meaningCN: 等出租车的人排得很长。

sentences.text: A driver offers to take me to the city.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位司机主动载我去市区。

sentences.text: I ask him if he can drive faster.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问他能不能开快一点。

sentences.text: He laughs and says the traffic is terrible.
sentences.meaningCN: 他笑着说交通太糟了。

sentences.text: We drive through the rain and the lights.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们穿过雨幕和灯光。

sentences.text: I call my hotel and say I will arrive late.
sentences.meaningCN: 我给酒店打电话，说我会晚到。

sentences.text: The hotel clerk says my room is ready.
sentences.meaningCN: 酒店前台说房间已经准备好了。

sentences.text: I feel tired but relieved.
sentences.meaningCN: 我累了，但松了口气。

sentences.text: The taxi stops in front of the hotel.
sentences.meaningCN: 出租车停在酒店门口。

sentences.text: I pay the driver and give him a tip.
sentences.meaningCN: 我付了车费，还给了小费。

sentences.text: The rain is still falling, but I am dry.
sentences.meaningCN: 雨还在下，但我是干的。

sentences.text: I check in and go straight to my room.
sentences.meaningCN: 我办了入住，直接回房间。

sentences.text: Tomorrow I will take the early train.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天我要坐早班火车。

sentences.text: For now, I just want to sleep.
sentences.meaningCN: 现在，我只想睡觉。

sentences.text: I open the window and listen to the rain.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打开窗，听雨声。

sentences.text: The room is small, but the bed is soft.
sentences.meaningCN: 房间不大，但床很软。

sentences.text: I put my wet coat on a chair.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把湿外套放在椅子上。

sentences.text: I set an alarm for six.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把闹钟定在六点。

sentences.text: Then I turn off the light.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后关了灯。

sentences.text: Tomorrow will be a better day.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天会更好。

sentences.text: I hear the rain on the window and feel calm.
sentences.meaningCN: 我听着窗上的雨声，感到平静。

sentences.text: The hotel is quiet, and the city is far away.
sentences.meaningCN: 酒店很安静，城市仿佛很远。

sentences.text: I close my eyes and let the day go.
sentences.meaningCN: 我闭上眼，把这一天放下。

sentences.text: Tomorrow I will start again with a clear plan.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天我会带着清晰的计划重新开始。

articles.title: First Day at the Office
articles.summaryCN: 入职第一天：自我介绍、工牌、会议室与茶歇。

sentences.text: Today is my first day at the office.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天是我到办公室的第一天。

sentences.text: I get up early and go to work by bus.
sentences.meaningCN: 我早起坐公交去上班。

sentences.text: The building is tall, and the lobby is bright.
sentences.meaningCN: 大楼很高，大堂很明亮。

sentences.text: A woman at the desk gives me a badge.
sentences.meaningCN: 前台女士给了我一张工牌。

sentences.text: She says my name is on the list.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说名单上有我的名字。

sentences.text: I meet my manager near the elevator.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在电梯旁见到了经理。

sentences.text: He says nice to meet you and shakes my hand.
sentences.meaningCN: 他说很高兴认识我，和我握手。

sentences.text: He shows me the meeting room.
sentences.meaningCN: 他带我看会议室。

sentences.text: The room has a long table and a large screen.
sentences.meaningCN: 房间里有一张长桌和一块大屏幕。

sentences.text: My desk is near the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的工位在窗边。

sentences.text: Could you help me please with the computer?
sentences.meaningCN: 你能帮我弄一下电脑吗？

sentences.text: I don't understand the password system.
sentences.meaningCN: 我不懂这个密码系统。

sentences.text: She explains it again and writes it down.
sentences.meaningCN: 她又解释了一遍，并写下来。

sentences.text: At ten, we take a coffee break.
sentences.meaningCN: 十点，我们去茶歇。

sentences.text: The coffee is strong, and the biscuits are good.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡很浓，饼干很好吃。

sentences.text: Everyone asks me where I am from.
sentences.meaningCN: 大家问我是哪里人。

sentences.text: I tell them about my city and my family.
sentences.meaningCN: 我跟他们讲我的城市和家庭。

sentences.text: They ask me about my old job.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们问我以前的工作。

sentences.text: I say I like the team already.
sentences.meaningCN: 我说我已经喜欢上这个团队了。

sentences.text: At noon, we eat lunch together.
sentences.meaningCN: 中午我们一起吃午饭。

sentences.text: The food is simple, but the conversation is warm.
sentences.meaningCN: 饭菜简单，但聊天很温暖。

sentences.text: In the afternoon, I read some documents.
sentences.meaningCN: 下午我读了一些文件。

sentences.text: I ask a lot of questions.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问了很多问题。

sentences.text: My manager says it is normal on the first day.
sentences.meaningCN: 经理说第一天这样很正常。

sentences.text: I leave the office at six.
sentences.meaningCN: 我六点离开办公室。

sentences.text: The city lights are bright on the way home.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家路上城市灯火明亮。

sentences.text: I feel tired but happy.
sentences.meaningCN: 我累但开心。

sentences.text: Tomorrow I will know more names.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天我会记住更多名字。

sentences.text: At home, I write down the names I learned.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家后，我写下学到的名字。

sentences.text: I make a small list for tomorrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 我为明天列了个小清单。

sentences.text: My family asks me about the day.
sentences.meaningCN: 家人问我今天怎么样。

sentences.text: I tell them the office is friendly.
sentences.meaningCN: 我告诉他们办公室的人很友好。

sentences.text: I go to bed early.
sentences.meaningCN: 我很早就睡了。

sentences.text: I feel ready for the next morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得已经准备好迎接第二天早晨。

sentences.text: I set my alarm and put my badge on the desk.
sentences.meaningCN: 我定好闹钟，把工牌放在桌上。

sentences.text: The first day was hard, but the people were kind.
sentences.meaningCN: 第一天很难，但大家都很友善。

sentences.text: I know the building a little better now.
sentences.meaningCN: 我现在对大楼熟悉了一点。

sentences.text: I look forward to my first real project.
sentences.meaningCN: 我期待我的第一个正式项目。

sentences.text: I think I will like working here.
sentences.meaningCN: 我想我会喜欢在这里工作。

articles.title: A Busy Monday Meeting
articles.summaryCN: 周一例会：议程、分歧、跟进邮件与收尾。

sentences.text: It is Monday morning, and the office is full of noise.
sentences.meaningCN: 周一早上，办公室很热闹。

sentences.text: We have a team meeting on Monday at nine.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们周一九点开团队会。

sentences.text: The manager puts the agenda on the screen.
sentences.meaningCN: 经理把议程放在屏幕上。

sentences.text: The first item is the new project plan.
sentences.meaningCN: 第一项是新项目计划。

sentences.text: I think the plan is too ambitious.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得这个计划太激进了。

sentences.text: I agree with the goal, but not the timeline.
sentences.meaningCN: 我同意目标，但不同意时间表。

sentences.text: Another colleague says I disagree with the cost.
sentences.meaningCN: 另一位同事说他不同意成本。

sentences.text: We discuss the budget for twenty minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们讨论了二十分钟预算。

sentences.text: I was wondering if we could start smaller.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在想我们能不能从小规模开始。

sentences.text: The manager writes my idea on the board.
sentences.meaningCN: 经理把我的想法写在白板上。

sentences.text: She says that is a good idea.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说这是个好主意。

sentences.text: We decide to test the plan with one team first.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们决定先在一个团队试点。

sentences.text: After the meeting, I need to follow up by email.
sentences.meaningCN: 会后，我需要发邮件跟进。

sentences.text: I write a short summary and send it to everyone.
sentences.meaningCN: 我写了一份简短总结，发给所有人。

sentences.text: A colleague calls me to check the numbers.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位同事打电话来核对数字。

sentences.text: We find a mistake in the third row.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们发现第三行有个错误。

sentences.text: I correct it and send the file again.
sentences.meaningCN: 我改正后重新发送文件。

sentences.text: At noon, I take a quick break.
sentences.meaningCN: 中午我短暂休息了一下。

sentences.text: The afternoon is quieter than the morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 下午比上午安静。

sentences.text: I finish two reports and answer many messages.
sentences.meaningCN: 我完成两份报告，回复了很多消息。

sentences.text: At five, I review my notes from the meeting.
sentences.meaningCN: 五点，我回顾会议笔记。

sentences.text: The plan is clearer now.
sentences.meaningCN: 计划现在更清楚了。

sentences.text: I make a list for Tuesday.
sentences.meaningCN: 我为周二列了清单。

sentences.text: I leave the office after six.
sentences.meaningCN: 我六点后离开办公室。

sentences.text: The bus is crowded, but I find a seat.
sentences.meaningCN: 公交很挤，但我找到了座位。

sentences.text: I listen to music and watch the city.
sentences.meaningCN: 我听音乐，看着城市。

sentences.text: It was a long day, but we made progress.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天很长，但我们有进展。

sentences.text: Tomorrow we will follow up with the client.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天我们会跟进客户。

sentences.text: I buy a sandwich and eat it in the park.
sentences.meaningCN: 我买了个三明治，在公园吃。

sentences.text: The sun comes out for a few minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 太阳出来了几分钟。

sentences.text: I check my messages before I go back.
sentences.meaningCN: 回去前我查看了消息。

sentences.text: The afternoon passes quickly.
sentences.meaningCN: 下午过得很快。

sentences.text: At six, I pack my bag and leave.
sentences.meaningCN: 六点，我收拾包离开。

sentences.text: I will sleep well tonight.
sentences.meaningCN: 今晚我会睡得很好。

sentences.text: The meeting was long, but the result was clear.
sentences.meaningCN: 会议很长，但结果很清楚。

sentences.text: I am glad we tested the plan first.
sentences.meaningCN: 我很高兴我们先做了试点。

sentences.text: Next week, we will check the numbers again.
sentences.meaningCN: 下周我们会再核对数字。

sentences.text: I close my laptop and say good night to the team.
sentences.meaningCN: 我合上电脑，和团队道晚安。

articles.title: Making an Appointment
articles.summaryCN: 医院预约与就诊：时间、保险卡、候诊室和用药叮嘱。

sentences.text: I feel sick, so I call a hospital near my home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我不舒服，所以打电话给家附近的医院。

sentences.text: I need an appointment with a doctor.
sentences.meaningCN: 我需要预约看医生。

sentences.text: The woman on the phone asks what time I can come.
sentences.meaningCN: 电话里的女士问我几点能来。

sentences.text: Could you repeat the address, please?
sentences.meaningCN: 你能重复一下地址吗？

sentences.text: Please speak slowly and give me the street name.
sentences.meaningCN: 请说慢一点，告诉我街道名。

sentences.text: I write it down and thank her.
sentences.meaningCN: 我记下来并道谢。

sentences.text: She asks for the insurance card at the desk.
sentences.meaningCN: 她在前台要保险卡。

sentences.text: I read the number from my card.
sentences.meaningCN: 我从卡上读出号码。

sentences.text: She says the waiting room is on the second floor.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说候诊室在二楼。

sentences.text: I arrive early and sit near the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 我提前到，坐在窗边。

sentences.text: The waiting room is quiet and clean.
sentences.meaningCN: 候诊室安静又干净。

sentences.text: A nurse calls my name and checks my temperature.
sentences.meaningCN: 护士叫我的名字，量了体温。

sentences.text: Could you help me please with the form?
sentences.meaningCN: 你能帮我填一下表吗？

sentences.text: I fill in my name, age, and address.
sentences.meaningCN: 我填上姓名、年龄和地址。

sentences.text: The doctor asks me how I feel.
sentences.meaningCN: 医生问我感觉怎么样。

sentences.text: I tell her about my headache and my cough.
sentences.meaningCN: 我告诉她我头痛、咳嗽。

sentences.text: She listens carefully and asks more questions.
sentences.meaningCN: 她仔细听，又问了一些问题。

sentences.text: She says I need rest and some medicine.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说我需要休息和吃药。

sentences.text: I ask if I can go to work tomorrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问明天能不能去上班。

sentences.text: She says I should stay home for one day.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说我应该在家待一天。

sentences.text: I thank her and leave the room.
sentences.meaningCN: 我道谢后离开诊室。

sentences.text: At the front desk, I pay for the visit.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在前台付了诊费。

sentences.text: The clerk gives me a receipt and a smile.
sentences.meaningCN: 工作人员递给我收据，笑了笑。

sentences.text: Outside, the sun is warm.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面阳光很暖。

sentences.text: I buy some fruit and go home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我买了些水果回家。

sentences.text: I take my medicine and sleep for two hours.
sentences.meaningCN: 我吃了药，睡了两个小时。

sentences.text: I feel better in the evening.
sentences.meaningCN: 晚上我感觉好多了。

sentences.text: Next time, I will call earlier.
sentences.meaningCN: 下次我会早点打电话。

sentences.text: The nurse gives me a glass of water.
sentences.meaningCN: 护士给了我一杯水。

sentences.text: I sit in the waiting room and read a poster.
sentences.meaningCN: 我坐在候诊室看海报。

sentences.text: It says that sleep is important for health.
sentences.meaningCN: 上面说睡眠对健康很重要。

sentences.text: I agree and close my eyes for a moment.
sentences.meaningCN: 我同意，闭眼休息了一会儿。

sentences.text: The doctor calls my name again.
sentences.meaningCN: 医生又叫了我的名字。

sentences.text: I stand up and follow her.
sentences.meaningCN: 我起身跟着她走。

sentences.text: She gives me a mask and asks me to wait.
sentences.meaningCN: 她给了我一个口罩，让我等一下。

sentences.text: The room is bright, and the bed is clean.
sentences.meaningCN: 房间很明亮，床很干净。

sentences.text: I feel a little nervous, but the doctor is kind.
sentences.meaningCN: 我有点紧张，但医生很和善。

sentences.text: I know I will be fine after some rest.
sentences.meaningCN: 我知道休息一下就会好。

articles.title: At the Pharmacy
articles.summaryCN: 药房取药：处方、副作用、服药说明与一次回访。

sentences.text: The doctor gives me a prescription for my cough.
sentences.meaningCN: 医生给我开了止咳处方。

sentences.text: I walk to a pharmacy next to the hospital.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走向医院旁边的一家药房。

sentences.text: The pharmacist is a kind woman with glasses.
sentences.meaningCN: 药剂师是位戴眼镜的友善女士。

sentences.text: I give her the prescription and wait.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把处方递给她，等着。

sentences.text: She asks if I am allergic to anything.
sentences.meaningCN: 她问我有没有过敏史。

sentences.text: I say no, but I am worried about the side effects.
sentences.meaningCN: 我说没有，但我担心副作用。

sentences.text: Could you explain how to take it?
sentences.meaningCN: 你能解释一下怎么服用吗？

sentences.text: She says I should take it with food.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说我应该随餐服用。

sentences.text: I ask her to say that again.
sentences.meaningCN: 我请她再说一遍。

sentences.text: She repeats the instruction slowly.
sentences.meaningCN: 她慢慢重复了说明。

sentences.text: I should take one pill in the morning and one at night.
sentences.meaningCN: 我应该在早晚各服一片。

sentences.text: I should not drink alcohol with this medicine.
sentences.meaningCN: 服这种药不能喝酒。

sentences.text: She also gives me some cough drops.
sentences.meaningCN: 她还给了我一些止咳含片。

sentences.text: I ask if I can drive after taking it.
sentences.meaningCN: 我问服药后能不能开车。

sentences.text: She says I may feel sleepy, so I should rest.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说我可能会犯困，应该休息。

sentences.text: I pay for the medicine and put it in my bag.
sentences.meaningCN: 我付了药费，把药放进包里。

sentences.text: On the way home, I buy a bottle of water.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家路上，我买了一瓶水。

sentences.text: I read the label again at the kitchen table.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在餐桌旁又看了一遍标签。

sentences.text: The instructions are clear and easy to follow.
sentences.meaningCN: 说明清楚易懂。

sentences.text: I take the first pill with a small meal.
sentences.meaningCN: 我随少量食物服下第一片药。

sentences.text: The medicine tastes bitter, but I swallow it.
sentences.meaningCN: 药很苦，但我咽了下去。

sentences.text: I lie down and close my eyes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我躺下，闭上眼睛。

sentences.text: In the afternoon, I feel a little better.
sentences.meaningCN: 下午我感觉好了一点。

sentences.text: I drink tea and read a book.
sentences.meaningCN: 我喝茶看书。

sentences.text: My friend calls to ask about my health.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友打电话问我身体怎么样。

sentences.text: I tell her the pharmacist was very helpful.
sentences.meaningCN: 我告诉她药剂师帮了很大忙。

sentences.text: She says she will visit tomorrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说说明天来看我。

sentences.text: I am grateful for the quiet day at home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我很感激在家度过的安静一天。

sentences.text: I put the medicine in a safe place.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把药放在安全的地方。

sentences.text: I write a note to take it at eight.
sentences.meaningCN: 我写了张便条，提醒八点吃药。

sentences.text: My mother calls and asks if I need anything.
sentences.meaningCN: 妈妈打电话问我要不要什么。

sentences.text: I say no thanks and tell her I am fine.
sentences.meaningCN: 我说不用了，谢谢，我很好。

sentences.text: She says she will bring some soup.
sentences.meaningCN: 她说会带些汤来。

sentences.text: I smile and wait for her.
sentences.meaningCN: 我笑了笑，等她来。

sentences.text: The soup is warm and tastes like home.
sentences.meaningCN: 汤很暖，有家的味道。

sentences.text: We talk for an hour and laugh a little.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们聊了一个小时，笑了几声。

sentences.text: I take my medicine again before bed.
sentences.meaningCN: 睡前我又吃了一次药。

sentences.text: The day was quiet, and I feel grateful.
sentences.meaningCN: 这一天很安静，我心怀感激。

articles.title: Hello, Neighbor
articles.summaryCN: 新邻居在楼道里打招呼，练最日常的问候与自我介绍。

sentences.text: Good morning, neighbor.
sentences.meaningCN: 早上好，邻居。

sentences.text: Good morning to you too.
sentences.meaningCN: 你也早上好。

sentences.text: I am Sam.
sentences.meaningCN: 我叫 Sam。

sentences.text: My name is Sam.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的名字是 Sam。

sentences.text: Nice to meet you.
sentences.meaningCN: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.text: Nice to meet you too.
sentences.meaningCN: 我也很高兴认识你。

sentences.text: This is my son.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是我儿子。

sentences.text: He is new here.
sentences.meaningCN: 他刚来这儿。

sentences.text: Do you live here?
sentences.meaningCN: 你住这儿吗？

sentences.text: Yes, we just moved in.
sentences.meaningCN: 是的，我们刚搬来。

sentences.text: The building is quiet.
sentences.meaningCN: 这栋楼很安静。

sentences.text: And the street is safe.
sentences.meaningCN: 街道也安全。

sentences.text: Thank you for the help.
sentences.meaningCN: 谢谢你的帮忙。

sentences.text: Thank you so much.
sentences.meaningCN: 真的很感谢你。

sentences.text: No problem at all.
sentences.meaningCN: 完全没问题。

sentences.text: Have a nice day.
sentences.meaningCN: 祝你今天愉快。

sentences.text: You too, Sam.
sentences.meaningCN: 你也是，Sam。

sentences.text: See you later.
sentences.meaningCN: 回头见。

sentences.text: See you tomorrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天见。

sentences.text: Have a good weekend.
sentences.meaningCN: 周末愉快。

sentences.text: Thanks, neighbor.
sentences.meaningCN: 谢谢你，邻居。

sentences.text: My son says hello.
sentences.meaningCN: 我儿子向你问好。

sentences.text: Hello to him.
sentences.meaningCN: 替我问好。

sentences.text: Is the coffee good?
sentences.meaningCN: 那里的咖啡好吗？

sentences.text: The cafe is great.
sentences.meaningCN: 那家咖啡店很棒。

sentences.text: I go there daily.
sentences.meaningCN: 我每天都去。

sentences.text: Me too, every day.
sentences.meaningCN: 我也是，每天。

sentences.text: Then we will meet.
sentences.meaningCN: 那我们会碰面。

sentences.text: Good morning again.
sentences.meaningCN: 再次早上好。

sentences.text: Goodbye for now.
sentences.meaningCN: 先这样，再见。

articles.title: Where Is the Station
articles.summaryCN: 在街口问路去车站：直走、左转、右转、拐角。

sentences.text: Excuse me, a question.
sentences.meaningCN: 打扰一下，问个问题。

sentences.text: Where is the station?
sentences.meaningCN: 车站在哪里？

sentences.text: The station is near.
sentences.meaningCN: 车站就在附近。

sentences.text: Please go straight.
sentences.meaningCN: 请直走。

sentences.text: Go straight for two blocks.
sentences.meaningCN: 直走过两个街区。

sentences.text: Then turn left.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后左转。

sentences.text: Turn left at the light.
sentences.meaningCN: 在红绿灯处左转。

sentences.text: Now turn right.
sentences.meaningCN: 现在右转。

sentences.text: Turn right at the corner.
sentences.meaningCN: 在拐角处右转。

sentences.text: It is at the corner.
sentences.meaningCN: 它就在拐角。

sentences.text: You will see a big sign.
sentences.meaningCN: 你会看到一个大牌子。

sentences.text: The station is behind it.
sentences.meaningCN: 车站就在后面。

sentences.text: Is it far from here?
sentences.meaningCN: 离这儿远吗？

sentences.text: No, it is five minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 不远，五分钟。

sentences.text: Just walk, it is easy.
sentences.meaningCN: 走着去就行，很容易。

sentences.text: Am I on the right road?
sentences.meaningCN: 我走的路对吗？

sentences.text: Yes, go straight from here.
sentences.meaningCN: 对，从这里直走。

sentences.text: Do not turn left here.
sentences.meaningCN: 这儿不要左转。

sentences.text: Turn right after the shop.
sentences.meaningCN: 商店之后再右转。

sentences.text: Then you will see it.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后你就看到了。

sentences.text: Thank you for the way.
sentences.meaningCN: 谢谢你指路。

sentences.text: You are welcome, friend.
sentences.meaningCN: 不客气，朋友。

sentences.text: Have a good trip.
sentences.meaningCN: 一路顺利。

sentences.text: The station, right?
sentences.meaningCN: 是车站，对吧？

sentences.text: Yes, the station ahead.
sentences.meaningCN: 对，车站就在前面。

sentences.text: I see the blue sign.
sentences.meaningCN: 我看到蓝色的牌子了。

sentences.text: That is the place.
sentences.meaningCN: 就是那儿。

sentences.text: Great, I found it.
sentences.meaningCN: 太好了，找到了。

sentences.text: Thank you again.
sentences.meaningCN: 再次感谢你。

sentences.text: Goodbye, and walk safe.
sentences.meaningCN: 再见，路上小心。

articles.title: At the Corner Shop
articles.summaryCN: 便利店买水和咖啡：要什么、怎么付、要不要袋子。

sentences.text: The shop is open late.
sentences.meaningCN: 这家店开得晚。

sentences.text: I come here often.
sentences.meaningCN: 我常来这儿。

sentences.text: Hello, just two things.
sentences.meaningCN: 你好，就买两样。

sentences.text: I'd like some water.
sentences.meaningCN: 我想要点水。

sentences.text: A bottle of water, please.
sentences.meaningCN: 请给我一瓶水。

sentences.text: And a coffee, hot.
sentences.meaningCN: 再来一杯热咖啡。

sentences.text: The coffee is fresh.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡很新鲜。

sentences.text: Do you need a bag?
sentences.meaningCN: 你需要袋子吗？

sentences.text: Yes, a small bag.
sentences.meaningCN: 要，一个小的。

sentences.text: Here is your food.
sentences.meaningCN: 你的吃的在这儿。

sentences.text: How much is it?
sentences.meaningCN: 多少钱？

sentences.text: It is six dollars.
sentences.meaningCN: 六美元。

sentences.text: Can I pay by card?
sentences.meaningCN: 我能刷卡吗？

sentences.text: Yes, pay by card here.
sentences.meaningCN: 可以，在这儿刷卡。

sentences.text: The machine is slow.
sentences.meaningCN: 机器有点慢。

sentences.text: No hurry at all.
sentences.meaningCN: 一点不急。

sentences.text: Do you want a receipt?
sentences.meaningCN: 你要小票吗？

sentences.text: Yes, a receipt please.
sentences.meaningCN: 要，请给我小票。

sentences.text: I use the self checkout.
sentences.meaningCN: 我用自助结账。

sentences.text: It is fast and easy.
sentences.meaningCN: 又快又简单。

sentences.text: The line is long today.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天队伍很长。

sentences.text: I wait near the door.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在门边等。

sentences.text: The clerk is kind.
sentences.meaningCN: 店员很和善。

sentences.text: She smiles and says thanks.
sentences.meaningCN: 她笑着说谢谢。

sentences.text: Thank you, have a good night.
sentences.meaningCN: 谢谢，晚上愉快。

sentences.text: You too, take care.
sentences.meaningCN: 你也是，慢走。

sentences.text: I'd like a quiet walk home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我想安静地走回家。

sentences.text: The street is calm now.
sentences.meaningCN: 街上现在很安静。

sentences.text: See you next time.
sentences.meaningCN: 下次再来。

sentences.text: Have a nice evening.
sentences.meaningCN: 晚上愉快。

articles.title: The Friday Wrap-Up
articles.summaryCN: 周五收尾：快速回顾、行动项、下周计划与准时交付。

sentences.text: It is Friday afternoon, and the office is finally calm.
sentences.meaningCN: 周五下午，办公室终于安静下来。

sentences.text: I think we all needed a slower hour.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得我们都需要慢一点的一个小时。

sentences.text: The meeting ran long, but we closed the last item.
sentences.meaningCN: 会开得很久，但我们把最后一项结了。

sentences.text: Could you send the notes when you have time?
sentences.meaningCN: 你有空时能把会议纪要发一下吗？

sentences.text: Got it, I will write them tonight.
sentences.meaningCN: 收到，我今晚就写。

sentences.text: A quick recap keeps everyone on the same page.
sentences.meaningCN: 一次快速回顾能让所有人对齐。

sentences.text: I will list the action items in one column.
sentences.meaningCN: 我会把行动项列在一栏里。

sentences.text: Each item gets one owner and one date.
sentences.meaningCN: 每项都有一个负责人和一个日期。

sentences.text: Nobody should leave with an unclear task.
sentences.meaningCN: 不该有人带着模糊的任务离开。

sentences.text: I prefer short lists over long emails.
sentences.meaningCN: 我更喜欢短清单而不是长邮件。

sentences.text: Long emails hide the two things that matter.
sentences.meaningCN: 长邮件会埋掉真正重要的两件事。

sentences.text: The deadline is Tuesday, not next Friday.
sentences.meaningCN: 截止日期是周二，不是下周五。

sentences.text: Next week we start the second phase.
sentences.meaningCN: 下周我们启动第二阶段。

sentences.text: Next week also has a review with the client.
sentences.meaningCN: 下周还有一次和客户过的评审。

sentences.text: Could you prepare the slides before Thursday?
sentences.meaningCN: 你能在周四前把幻灯片准备好吗？

sentences.text: I can do that if I get the data today.
sentences.meaningCN: 如果今天拿到数据，我就能做。

sentences.text: The data lives in a shared folder, I think.
sentences.meaningCN: 数据在共享文件夹里，我猜。

sentences.text: I will ask the team for access this afternoon.
sentences.meaningCN: 我今天下午会向团队要权限。

sentences.text: Please keep the numbers simple and honest.
sentences.meaningCN: 请把数字弄得简单、诚实。

sentences.text: Simple numbers make better decisions.
sentences.meaningCN: 简单的数字能带来更好的决策。

sentences.text: We agreed to ship on time, not early and rough.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们同意按时交付，而不是提前交粗糙的东西。

sentences.text: Being on time builds trust with the client.
sentences.meaningCN: 准时能建立客户的信任。

sentences.text: I agree, and I will say so in the review.
sentences.meaningCN: 我同意，评审时我会这么说。

sentences.text: If anything slips, tell me early.
sentences.meaningCN: 如果有延误，尽早告诉我。

sentences.text: Early warnings are cheaper than late surprises.
sentences.meaningCN: 提前预警比事后惊吓便宜。

sentences.text: Got it, I will flag risks on Monday.
sentences.meaningCN: 明白，我周一就把风险标出来。

sentences.text: Monday morning is a good time for that.
sentences.meaningCN: 周一上午正适合做这件事。

sentences.text: We can move the smaller tasks to next week.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们可以把小事挪到下周。

sentences.text: The client only sees the finished part.
sentences.meaningCN: 客户只看到完成的部分。

sentences.text: So let us protect the team's quiet time.
sentences.meaningCN: 所以让我们保住团队的安静时间。

sentences.text: I was glad the meeting ended early today.
sentences.meaningCN: 很高兴今天的会提前结束了。

sentences.text: We still have real work to do this week.
sentences.meaningCN: 这周我们还有真正的活儿。

sentences.text: But the plan is clear, and that helps.
sentences.meaningCN: 不过计划清楚了，这就很有帮助。

sentences.text: Let us call it a day and rest.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天就到这儿，去休息吧。

sentences.text: Rest is part of the work, not a reward.
sentences.meaningCN: 休息是工作的一部分，不是奖赏。

sentences.text: See you Monday, refreshed and ready.
sentences.meaningCN: 周一见，精神饱满地开始。

sentences.text: Have a good weekend, everyone.
sentences.meaningCN: 祝大家周末愉快。

sentences.text: Thank you all for a clean finish.
sentences.meaningCN: 谢谢大家把这一周收得干净。

sentences.text: The office is dark, and the week is done.
sentences.meaningCN: 办公室熄了灯，这一周结束了。

sentences.text: I lock the door and head home.
sentences.meaningCN: 我锁门回家。

articles.title: Delayed Again at the Desk
articles.summaryCN: 又一次延误：改签、登机口变更、酒店券与行李重新托运。

sentences.text: The board says delayed, and the hall fills with sighs.
sentences.meaningCN: 屏幕上写着延误，大厅里满是叹气。

sentences.text: It is rainy outside, so more flights are late.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面下着雨，所以更多航班晚点。

sentences.text: I walk to the desk and join the longest line.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走到柜台，排进最长的队伍。

sentences.text: What time is the next available flight?
sentences.meaningCN: 下一个有位的航班是几点？

sentences.text: The agent checks her screen and says an hour.
sentences.meaningCN: 工作人员看了看屏幕，说一小时。

sentences.text: An hour is fine, I have nowhere to be.
sentences.meaningCN: 一小时没关系，我哪儿也不赶。

sentences.text: But then comes a gate change notice.
sentences.meaningCN: 但接着来了登机口变更的通知。

sentences.text: Gate twelve is now gate twenty-six.
sentences.meaningCN: 十二号口改成了二十六号口。

sentences.text: I need to rebook my flight, not just wait.
sentences.meaningCN: 我需要改签，而不只是等。

sentences.text: Could you put me on the morning flight?
sentences.meaningCN: 能把我改到早班机吗？

sentences.text: The agent types slowly and then nods.
sentences.meaningCN: 工作人员慢慢地打字，然后点头。

sentences.text: Yes, that seat is still open today.
sentences.meaningCN: 可以，今天那个座位还空着。

sentences.text: My bag is already checked in downstairs.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的行李已经在楼下托运了。

sentences.text: Will it reach the airport before I do?
sentences.meaningCN: 它会比我先到机场吗？

sentences.text: The airport is large, and the transfer is tight.
sentences.meaningCN: 机场很大，转机很紧。

sentences.text: I ask for a hotel voucher for the night.
sentences.meaningCN: 我要一张当晚的酒店券。

sentences.text: They give me a voucher and a breakfast card.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们给了我一张券和一份早餐卡。

sentences.text: A bit later, the screen changes again.
sentences.meaningCN: 过了一会儿，屏幕又变了。

sentences.text: The new flight leaves at six sharp.
sentences.meaningCN: 新航班六点整起飞。

sentences.text: I find a chair near the window and sit.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在窗边找了把椅子坐下。

sentences.text: A man beside me works on a small laptop.
sentences.meaningCN: 我旁边的男人在小笔记本上工作。

sentences.text: His child sleeps under a thin blanket.
sentences.meaningCN: 他的孩子在薄毯子下睡着。

sentences.text: Nobody complains loudly, which feels kind.
sentences.meaningCN: 没有人大声抱怨，这让人觉得善意。

sentences.text: We share the news like a small community.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们像个小集体一样分享消息。

sentences.text: The coffee here costs more than the flight.
sentences.meaningCN: 这里的咖啡比机票还贵。

sentences.text: Still, I buy one and wait without hurry.
sentences.meaningCN: 但我还是买了一杯，不着急地等。

sentences.text: I was wondering if the gate will change again.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在想登机口会不会再变。

sentences.text: It does not, and we board in one group.
sentences.meaningCN: 没有变，我们一组人登机。

sentences.text: The plane is late, but it is ours now.
sentences.meaningCN: 飞机晚点了，但此刻是我们的了。

sentences.text: I stow my bag and look out at the rain.
sentences.meaningCN: 我放好行李，看向外面的雨。

sentences.text: Delay teaches patience at an awkward price.
sentences.meaningCN: 延误以别扭的代价教会人耐心。

sentences.text: Next time I will build in a longer gap.
sentences.meaningCN: 下次我会留出更长的间隔。

sentences.text: I will check in online the night before.
sentences.meaningCN: 我会在前一晚网上值机。

sentences.text: And I will keep this voucher as a story.
sentences.meaningCN: 我会把这张券留成一个故事。

sentences.text: The engine hums, and the hall falls away.
sentences.meaningCN: 引擎轰鸣，大厅渐渐远去。

sentences.text: Somewhere ahead, my morning is still waiting.
sentences.meaningCN: 在前方某处，我的早晨仍在等待。

sentences.text: I close my eyes and let the night pass.
sentences.meaningCN: 我闭上眼睛，让夜里过去。

sentences.text: By dawn, the delay feels almost small.
sentences.meaningCN: 到拂晓，延误几乎变得渺小。

sentences.text: The pilot apologizes and thanks us kindly.
sentences.meaningCN: 机长道歉并客气地感谢我们。

sentences.text: We land early, which nobody expected today.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们提前落地，谁也没料到。

articles.title: Late Night Radio
articles.summaryCN: 深夜电台独白：关于慢下来的节奏、凌晨与自我说服。

sentences.text: It is past midnight, and the city has finally stopped explaining itself to me.
sentences.meaningCN: 已经过了午夜，城市终于不再向我解释它自己。

sentences.text: I think that is the real gift of the small hours.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得这正是凌晨时段真正的礼物。

sentences.text: Nobody expects a reply before sunrise, and the silence is not rude.
sentences.meaningCN: 没人期待日出前有回复，而这种沉默并不失礼。

sentences.text: I prefer the slower version of my own thinking.
sentences.meaningCN: 我更喜欢自己思考里更慢的那个版本。

sentences.text: In daylight, thought arrives already dressed for work.
sentences.meaningCN: 在白天，想法一到达就已经穿好上班的衣服。

sentences.text: At night it comes in bare feet, unhurried and honest.
sentences.meaningCN: 夜里它光着脚来，不慌不忙，也很诚实。

sentences.text: To be honest, I have been running at a speed I never chose.
sentences.meaningCN: 说实话，我一直在用一个自己从未选过的速度奔跑。

sentences.text: The schedule was written by other hands, and I simply agreed.
sentences.meaningCN: 日程是别人的手写的，我只是同意了。

sentences.text: Somewhere along the way, agreement started to look like ambition.
sentences.meaningCN: 在某个路口之后，同意开始看起来像野心。

sentences.text: It is important to notice the difference before you are tired.
sentences.meaningCN: 在疲惫之前察觉这个差别，很重要。

sentences.text: A slower pace is not laziness wearing a nicer coat.
sentences.meaningCN: 更慢的节奏不是懒惰穿了件更好看的外套。

sentences.text: It is a decision about which things deserve your attention.
sentences.meaningCN: 它是关于哪些事值得你注意力的决定。

sentences.text: I have learned to keep one hour empty, like a window.
sentences.meaningCN: 我学会留出一个空白小时，像一扇窗。

sentences.text: Nothing is scheduled there, and everything is possible.
sentences.meaningCN: 那里没有安排，却一切皆有可能。

sentences.text: Sometimes I sit with a cup of tea and do absolutely nothing, though the first attempts felt uncomfortable and almost rude.
sentences.meaningCN: 有时我端着一杯茶什么都不做，尽管最初的尝试让人不安，几乎算失礼。

sentences.text: My hands reached for the phone out of pure habit, but I stayed anyway, and the discomfort passed like weather.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的手出于习惯去拿手机，但我还是留下来，那种不适像天气一样过去了。

sentences.text: I think most people underestimate how fast boredom leaves.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得大多数人低估了无聊离开的速度。

sentences.text: What arrives afterwards is usually a small, useful idea that rarely shouts and tends to whisper and wait.
sentences.meaningCN: 之后到来的通常是一个小而有用的想法，它很少喊叫，而是低语并等待。

sentences.text: To be honest, some of my best decisions were whispers.
sentences.meaningCN: 说实话，我一些最好的决定都是低语。

sentences.text: The loud ones belonged to other people's calendars.
sentences.meaningCN: 那些大声的属于别人的日历。

sentences.text: I would rather be late to a meeting than early to a mistake.
sentences.meaningCN: 我宁愿开会迟到，也不愿过早犯错。

sentences.text: That line sounds careless until you have tried it twice, and stay calm is the instruction I repeat most often now.
sentences.meaningCN: 这句话听起来草率，直到你试过两次；而保持平静是如今我重复最多的一句指令。

sentences.text: Not calm as in numb, but calm as in clear water where you can see the bottom and read the stones.
sentences.meaningCN: 不是麻木的平静，而是清水般的平静，你能看见水底，读懂石头。

sentences.text: I keep a notebook by the bed for these late transmissions, though most entries are three words long and useless by morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 我在床边放一本笔记本记这些深夜播报，尽管多数条目只有三个词，到早上就没用了。

sentences.text: But one in ten changes the entire following week, and that ratio is cheap enough to pay much more for.
sentences.meaningCN: 但十分之一会改变接下来的整个一周，这个比例便宜到值得付更多。

sentences.text: The radio plays something old and nobody asks for a request, which is a pleasure in receiving what you did not choose.
sentences.meaningCN: 电台放着一首老歌，没人点歌，这种接受你没选的东西本身就是一种愉悦。

sentences.text: I prefer this to the endless menu of my own device.
sentences.meaningCN: 我更喜欢这样，而不是我设备上的无尽菜单。

sentences.text: The host speaks softly, as if reading to an empty room.
sentences.meaningCN: 主播轻声说话，像在给空房间朗读。

sentences.text: It is important, I think, to be addressed so gently.
sentences.meaningCN: 我觉得，被人如此温柔地对待很重要。

sentences.text: Gentleness is not a weakness that serious people outgrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 温柔不是严肃的人长大后会丢掉的弱点。

sentences.text: It is a skill, and like most skills it needs quiet practice.
sentences.meaningCN: 它是一种技能，和多数技能一样需要安静地练习。

sentences.text: By now the traffic has gone, and the street sounds wider.
sentences.meaningCN: 此刻车流散去，街道听起来更宽阔。

sentences.text: I will sleep without a plan for tomorrow, which is rare.
sentences.meaningCN: 我会不带明日计划地睡去，这很难得。

sentences.text: Tomorrow will ask its usual questions, and I will answer late.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天会照例提问，我会晚一点回答。

sentences.text: For now, the small hours hold the door open for me, so good night from a city that has stopped explaining itself.
sentences.meaningCN: 此刻，凌晨为我扶着门，所以请接受这座不再解释自己的城市的晚安。

articles.title: A Chat in the Hall
articles.summaryCN: 楼道里的第一次寒暄：问名字、说状态、约在咖啡馆见。

sentences.text: Hi, I am Mia.
sentences.meaningCN: 嗨，我是米娅。

sentences.text: I live in this building.
sentences.meaningCN: 我住在这栋楼里。

sentences.text: This is my first week here.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是我在这里的第一周。

sentences.text: A man walks to the door.
sentences.meaningCN: 一个男人走到门口。

sentences.text: "Hello," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “你好，”他说。

sentences.text: "What's your name?"
sentences.meaningCN: “你叫什么名字？”

sentences.text: "I'm Mia," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我叫米娅，”我说。

sentences.text: "I'm Ben," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “我是本，”他说。

sentences.text: "Nice to meet you, Ben."
sentences.meaningCN: “很高兴认识你，本。”

sentences.text: "How are you today?"
sentences.meaningCN: “你今天怎么样？”

sentences.text: "I'm fine, thank you."
sentences.meaningCN: “我很好，谢谢。”

sentences.text: "Me too," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “我也是，”他说。

sentences.text: "Do you like this street?"
sentences.meaningCN: “你喜欢这条街吗？”

sentences.text: "Yes, it is quiet."
sentences.meaningCN: “喜欢，很安静。”

sentences.text: "There is a small cafe."
sentences.meaningCN: “有一家小咖啡馆。”

sentences.text: Great, I love coffee.
sentences.meaningCN: 太棒了，我爱喝咖啡。

sentences.text: You can come with me.
sentences.meaningCN: 你可以和我一起去。

sentences.text: Thanks a lot.
sentences.meaningCN: 太谢谢了。

sentences.text: "You're welcome," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “不客气。”我说。

sentences.text: "When do you go?" he asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “你什么时候去？”他问。

sentences.text: I go there at nine.
sentences.meaningCN: 我九点去那儿。

sentences.text: "See you there."
sentences.meaningCN: “那儿见。”

sentences.text: "Take care, Ben."
sentences.meaningCN: “保重，本。”

sentences.text: "Good night, Mia."
sentences.meaningCN: “晚安，米娅。”

sentences.text: I go back inside.
sentences.meaningCN: 我回到楼里。

sentences.text: The cafe opens at eight.
sentences.meaningCN: 那家咖啡馆八点开门。

sentences.text: I can go there tomorrow.
sentences.meaningCN: 我明天可以去那儿。

articles.title: Bread and Change
articles.summaryCN: 周末早晨在街角店买面包和水，练有没有、多少钱和找零。

sentences.text: It is Saturday morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 这是星期六早上。

sentences.text: I walk to the corner shop.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走向街角的商店。

sentences.text: The door is open.
sentences.meaningCN: 门开着。

sentences.text: A woman stands at the desk.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位女士站在柜台后。

sentences.text: "Do you have fresh bread?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “你们有新鲜面包吗？”我问。

sentences.text: "Yes, we do," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “有的，”她说。

sentences.text: "How much is the bread?"
sentences.meaningCN: “面包多少钱？”

sentences.text: "Two dollars," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “两美元，”她说。

sentences.text: "I take two, please."
sentences.meaningCN: “我要两个。”

sentences.text: "Anything else?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “还要别的吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "Yes please, a bottle of water."
sentences.meaningCN: “好的，请再给我一瓶水。”

sentences.text: "That is three dollars."
sentences.meaningCN: “一共三美元。”

sentences.text: I give her five dollars.
sentences.meaningCN: 我给她五美元。

sentences.text: "Keep the change," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “不用找零了，”我说。

sentences.text: "Thank you," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “谢谢，”她说。

sentences.text: "Would you like milk today?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “今天要牛奶吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "No thank you," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “不用了，谢谢，”我说。

sentences.text: "That is all," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “就这些，”我说。

sentences.text: I look at my watch.
sentences.meaningCN: 我看了看表。

sentences.text: It is five to nine.
sentences.meaningCN: 现在差五分九点。

sentences.text: The shop is busy now.
sentences.meaningCN: 商店现在忙起来了。

sentences.text: "It's closed on Sunday," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “周日不营业，”她说。

sentences.text: I nod and leave.
sentences.meaningCN: 我点点头离开了。

sentences.text: The bread smells good.
sentences.meaningCN: 面包闻起来很香。

articles.title: Lunch With a Friend
articles.summaryCN: 和朋友在街角小馆吃午饭：点汤、要水、吃到饱、一起结账。

sentences.text: My friend Leo meets me at a small restaurant.
sentences.meaningCN: 朋友利奥在一家小餐馆和我碰面。

sentences.text: We sit by the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们坐在窗边。

sentences.text: "This place is new," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “这家店是新开的，”他说。

sentences.text: "I like the music here."
sentences.meaningCN: “我喜欢这里的音乐。”

sentences.text: "I don't like loud places," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我不喜欢吵闹的地方，”我说。

sentences.text: "It's good and quiet," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “这里挺好，也安静，”他说。

sentences.text: A waiter brings two menus.
sentences.meaningCN: 服务员拿来两份菜单。

sentences.text: "Could I have the soup?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “能给我来份汤吗？”我问。

sentences.text: "Would you like some bread with it?" he asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “要配点面包吗？”他问。

sentences.text: "Yes, that sounds nice."
sentences.meaningCN: “好啊，听起来不错。”

sentences.text: "I need a glass of water too."
sentences.meaningCN: “我还需要一杯水。”

sentences.text: "Same for me," says Leo.
sentences.meaningCN: “我也一样，”利奥说。

sentences.text: We talk about our busy week at work.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们聊起工作里忙碌的一周。

sentences.text: He has a new job in the city center.
sentences.meaningCN: 他在市中心找了份新工作。

sentences.text: I am happy for him.
sentences.meaningCN: 我为他高兴。

sentences.text: The food comes after ten minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 十分钟后菜上来了。

sentences.text: The soup is hot and fresh.
sentences.meaningCN: 汤热腾腾的，很新鲜。

sentences.text: "How is your pasta?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “你的意面怎么样？”我问。

sentences.text: "It's good, very rich."
sentences.meaningCN: “很好吃，味道很浓。”

sentences.text: We eat slowly and laugh a lot.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们慢慢吃，笑了很多。

sentences.text: Later I feel full.
sentences.meaningCN: 后来我吃饱了。

sentences.text: "I can't finish this," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我吃不完了，”我说。

sentences.text: "Me neither," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “我也吃不完，”他说。

sentences.text: We wait for the bill at the table.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们在桌边等账单。

sentences.text: The waiter brings it with a warm smile.
sentences.meaningCN: 服务员带着笑意把账单送来。

sentences.text: "How much is it?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “多少钱？”我问。

sentences.text: We pay together and leave a tip.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们一起付了钱，还留了小费。

sentences.text: The evening air is cool and clean outside.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面的晚风凉爽又干净。

sentences.text: On the way home we pass a bakery.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家的路上我们经过一家面包店。

sentences.text: "Do you want dessert?" Leo asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “要甜点吗？”利奥问。

sentences.text: "No, I feel full," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “不了，我吃饱了，”我说。

articles.title: A Checkup at the Clinic
articles.summaryCN: 门诊复查：过敏史、确认信息、听诊与喝水叮嘱，练确认澄清。

sentences.text: I have a checkup at the clinic this morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 我今天上午去诊所复查。

sentences.text: The waiting room is full of people.
sentences.meaningCN: 候诊室里坐满了人。

sentences.text: It is hot in here, and the air feels heavy.
sentences.meaningCN: 这里很热，空气也闷。

sentences.text: A nurse in blue calls my name.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位穿蓝制服的护士叫我的名字。

sentences.text: "Do you have food allergies?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “你有食物过敏吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "Yes, I cannot eat nuts or eggs."
sentences.meaningCN: “有，我不能吃坚果和鸡蛋。”

sentences.text: "Are you sure about the eggs?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “鸡蛋也确定吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "I'm certain," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我确定，”我说。

sentences.text: "Say pardon?" she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “请再说一遍？”她说。

sentences.text: "I'm certain about the eggs," I say again.
sentences.meaningCN: “鸡蛋我确定，”我又说了一遍。

sentences.text: "I get it," she says and writes it down.
sentences.meaningCN: “我明白了，”她说着记了下来。

sentences.text: Then she checks my heart and my blood pressure.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后她检查我的心率和血压。

sentences.text: "What do you mean by that number?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “那个数字是什么意思？”我问。

sentences.text: "Your numbers are normal," she says with a smile.
sentences.meaningCN: “你的指标正常，”她笑着说。

sentences.text: "That is good news for me."
sentences.meaningCN: “这对我来说是好消息。”

sentences.text: "Do you feel thirsty often?" she asks me.
sentences.meaningCN: “你经常觉得渴吗？”她问我。

sentences.text: "Not really, only after sport," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “不太会，只有运动后会，”我说。

sentences.text: She tells me to drink more water every day.
sentences.meaningCN: 她让我每天多喝水。

sentences.text: I nod and thank her for the advice.
sentences.meaningCN: 我点点头，谢过她的建议。

sentences.text: The doctor comes in after a few minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 几分钟后医生进来了。

sentences.text: He asks me about my sleep.
sentences.meaningCN: 他问我睡眠怎么样。

sentences.text: "I sleep about seven hours," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我大概睡七个小时，”我说。

sentences.text: "That is fine," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “那挺好的，”他说。

sentences.text: He listens to my breathing.
sentences.meaningCN: 他听我的呼吸。

sentences.text: "Everything looks fine," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “一切看起来都正常，”他说。

sentences.text: "I am glad," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我很高兴，”我说。

sentences.text: I take my bag and leave the room.
sentences.meaningCN: 我拿起包离开房间。

sentences.text: The air outside is cool and fresh.
sentences.meaningCN: 外面的空气凉爽清新。

sentences.text: I feel relaxed now.
sentences.meaningCN: 我现在觉得放松。

sentences.text: The clinic was not busy at all.
sentences.meaningCN: 诊所一点也不忙。

sentences.text: I walk home slowly and buy some fruit.
sentences.meaningCN: 我慢慢走回家，还买了些水果。

articles.title: Planning the Week
articles.summaryCN: 周一上午和主管排本周计划：空档确认、谨慎表态、纪要分工与待办清单。

sentences.text: On Monday morning the office is quiet and cold.
sentences.meaningCN: 周一早上，办公室安静又冷。

sentences.text: I arrive early and turn on the lights.
sentences.meaningCN: 我到得早，把灯打开。

sentences.text: My manager, Anna, walks in with a laptop.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的主管安娜抱着笔记本走进来。

sentences.text: "Are you free at ten?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “你十点有空吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "I have a call at nine, but ten works," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我九点有个电话，但十点可以，”我说。

sentences.text: "Good, we need to plan the week," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “好，我们得排一下这周，”她说。

sentences.text: I open my notebook and check my email.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打开笔记本，查了查邮件。

sentences.text: "I'm not sure about the client meeting," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “客户会议我还不确定，”我说。

sentences.text: "It is still on Thursday, isn't it?"
sentences.meaningCN: “还是周四吧？”

sentences.text: "Yes, unless they change it again."
sentences.meaningCN: “是，除非他们又改。”

sentences.text: Anna smiles and sits down.
sentences.meaningCN: 安娜笑了笑坐下。

sentences.text: "May I see the latest numbers?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “我可以看看最新数据吗？”我问。

sentences.text: "Of course, they are in the shared folder."
sentences.meaningCN: “当然，在共享文件夹里。”

sentences.text: We go through them together for half an hour.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们一起过了一遍，花了半小时。

sentences.text: The numbers look better than last month.
sentences.meaningCN: 数据比上个月好看。

sentences.text: "We should send a short recap after the meeting," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “会后我们该发一份简短回顾，”她说。

sentences.text: "I can write it if you don't mind," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “如果你不介意，我来写，”我说。

sentences.text: "That would help a lot," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “那太有帮助了，”她说。

sentences.text: At ten we walk to the small meeting room.
sentences.meaningCN: 十点我们走去小会议室。

sentences.text: "After you," I say at the door.
sentences.meaningCN: “您先请，”我在门口说。

sentences.text: "Thanks," she says and opens the door.
sentences.meaningCN: “谢谢，”她说着推开门。

sentences.text: The room is bright but a little small.
sentences.meaningCN: 房间很亮，但有点小。

sentences.text: We list three goals on the whiteboard.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们在白板上列了三个目标。

sentences.text: "When you can, send the recap to the team," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “你方便的时候，把回顾发给团队，”她说。

sentences.text: "I will do it right after lunch."
sentences.meaningCN: “我午饭后马上做。”

sentences.text: Then we make a to-do list for the week.
sentences.meaningCN: 接着我们列了本周的待办清单。

sentences.text: Mine has five items and hers has seven.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的有五项，她的有七项。

sentences.text: "Let me help with the budget sheet," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “预算表我来帮忙吧，”我说。

sentences.text: "Great, that saves me an hour," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “太好了，这能给我省一小时，”她说。

sentences.text: The meeting ends before eleven.
sentences.meaningCN: 会议在十一点前结束。

sentences.text: I go back to my desk and open the file.
sentences.meaningCN: 我回到座位，打开文件。

sentences.text: The budget sheet is long but clear.
sentences.meaningCN: 预算表很长，但很清楚。

sentences.text: At noon my stomach makes a small sound.
sentences.meaningCN: 中午，我的肚子轻轻叫了一声。

sentences.text: I finish the sheet and send the recap.
sentences.meaningCN: 我做完表，把回顾发了出去。

articles.title: A Late Check-In
articles.summaryCN: 深夜落地后入住机场酒店：找预订、要房间、问电梯与夜宵，练求助。

sentences.text: My flight lands late, after midnight.
sentences.meaningCN: 我的航班深夜落地，已经过了午夜。

sentences.text: The airport is almost empty.
sentences.meaningCN: 机场几乎空了。

sentences.text: I take a taxi to the hotel near the terminal.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打车去航站楼附近的酒店。

sentences.text: The driver says the trip is very short.
sentences.meaningCN: 司机说路程很短。

sentences.text: "How far is the hotel?" I ask him.
sentences.meaningCN: “酒店有多远？”我问他。

sentences.text: "About five minutes," he answers.
sentences.meaningCN: “大概五分钟，”他回答。

sentences.text: The hotel lobby is warm and bright.
sentences.meaningCN: 酒店大堂温暖明亮。

sentences.text: A young man stands behind the desk.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位年轻男士站在前台后。

sentences.text: "I'm looking for my reservation," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我在找我的预订，”我说。

sentences.text: "What is your name, please?" he asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “请问您的名字？”他问。

sentences.text: I give him my passport and he types.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把护照递给他，他敲起键盘。

sentences.text: "I need a room for two nights," I add.
sentences.meaningCN: “我需要住两晚，”我补充道。

sentences.text: "Your room is on the eighth floor," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “您的房间在八楼，”他说。

sentences.text: "Can you tell me where the elevator is?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “能告诉我电梯在哪吗？”我问。

sentences.text: "It is just behind the stairs," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “就在楼梯后面，”他说。

sentences.text: He gives me a key card and a map.
sentences.meaningCN: 他给我一张门卡和一张地图。

sentences.text: "Where can I get some food at this hour?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “这个点我在哪能弄点吃的？”我问。

sentences.text: "Room service is open all night," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “客房服务整夜都开，”他说。

sentences.text: "I'd love to order a sandwich," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “我很想点一个三明治，”我说。

sentences.text: He calls the kitchen for me.
sentences.meaningCN: 他替我打电话给厨房。

sentences.text: Then he hands me a room key as well.
sentences.meaningCN: 然后他又递给我一把房间钥匙。

sentences.text: "The key card is for the front door, and the small key is for the balcony," he explains.
sentences.meaningCN: “门卡是开前门的，小钥匙是开阳台的，”他解释。

sentences.text: I thank him and walk to the elevator.
sentences.meaningCN: 我谢过他，走向电梯。

sentences.text: The room is small but clean.
sentences.meaningCN: 房间不大，但很干净。

sentences.text: I open the window and hear the sea.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打开窗户，听见海的声音。

sentences.text: Twenty minutes later, someone knocks.
sentences.meaningCN: 二十分钟后，有人敲门。

sentences.text: The sandwich is hot and the tea is strong.
sentences.meaningCN: 三明治是热的，茶很浓。

sentences.text: I eat slowly and watch the dark street.
sentences.meaningCN: 我慢慢吃着，看着昏暗的街道。

sentences.text: Before bed I check my phone.
sentences.meaningCN: 睡前我看了看手机。

sentences.text: My sister asks if I arrived safely.
sentences.meaningCN: 姐姐问我是否平安到了。

sentences.text: I answer with a short message.
sentences.meaningCN: 我用一条简短的消息回复。

sentences.text: I set an alarm for seven.
sentences.meaningCN: 我把闹钟定在七点。

sentences.text: The bed is soft and the room is quiet.
sentences.meaningCN: 床很软，房间很安静。

sentences.text: I fall asleep in just a few minutes.
sentences.meaningCN: 我几分钟内就睡着了。

articles.title: Morning Habits, On Air
articles.summaryCN: 早间电台访谈：起床先看手机、改习惯、周末补觉与睡前放手机。

sentences.text: Welcome back to the Morning Show on Radio Seven, where we talk about everyday habits.
sentences.meaningCN: 欢迎回到七台早间节目，我们在这里聊日常习惯。

sentences.text: Today our guest is Dr. Lena Park, a researcher who studies sleep and attention.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天的嘉宾是研究睡眠与注意力的莉娜·帕克博士。

sentences.text: "Thanks for having me on the show again," she says with a smile.
sentences.meaningCN: “谢谢再次邀请我来节目，”她笑着说。

sentences.text: "So, Dr. Park, how do most people start their day?" I ask.
sentences.meaningCN: “那么，帕克博士，大多数人一天是怎么开始的？”我问。

sentences.text: "Many people check phone messages before they even leave the bed," she explains.
sentences.meaningCN: “很多人还没下床就先看手机消息，”她解释。

sentences.text: "That sounds exactly like me," I admit.
sentences.meaningCN: “这说的就是我，”我承认。

sentences.text: "Is that really a problem for our health?"
sentences.meaningCN: “这对健康真的是个问题吗？”

sentences.text: "It could be, for some people," she answers carefully.
sentences.meaningCN: “对一些人来说可能是，”她谨慎地回答。

sentences.text: "No way," I say. "I do it every single morning."
sentences.meaningCN: “不会吧，”我说，“我每天早上都这样。”

sentences.text: She laughs and then explains what happens in the brain.
sentences.meaningCN: 她笑了，然后解释大脑里发生了什么。

sentences.text: The bright light from the screen wakes the mind much too fast.
sentences.meaningCN: 屏幕的强光会让大脑过快地被唤醒。

sentences.text: "Of course, some people are completely fine with it," she adds.
sentences.meaningCN: “当然，有些人对它完全没问题，”她补充。

sentences.text: "I see," I say. "So what should we do instead?"
sentences.meaningCN: “我明白了，”我说，“那我们该怎么做？”

sentences.text: "Start with a glass of water and a little sunlight," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “先喝一杯水，晒一点太阳，”她说。

sentences.text: "Why not open the window before you pick up the phone?"
sentences.meaningCN: “何不在拿手机之前先打开窗户？”

sentences.text: "That is a very simple idea," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “这个想法很简单，”我说。

sentences.text: "Simple habits are much easier to keep for a long time," she explains.
sentences.meaningCN: “简单的习惯更容易长期坚持，”她解释。

sentences.text: Our next caller is a teacher from the north of the country.
sentences.meaningCN: 下一位来电者是本国北部的一位老师。

sentences.text: "I'd say no to early alarms on dark winter mornings," he says.
sentences.meaningCN: “在冬天漆黑的早晨，我会说不要早起闹钟，”他说。

sentences.text: "But school starts at eight, so what can you do?" I answer.
sentences.meaningCN: “但学校八点开始，你能怎么办呢？”我回应。

sentences.text: "Then go to bed a little earlier," says Dr. Park.
sentences.meaningCN: “那就早点睡，”帕克博士说。

sentences.text: "Let's go through the list one more time before the break," I say.
sentences.meaningCN: “休息前我们再过一遍清单，”我说。

sentences.text: "Water, light, and a short walk outside," she repeats slowly.
sentences.meaningCN: “水、光，还有到户外短走一段，”她慢慢重复。

sentences.text: "And no phone in bed at night," I add.
sentences.meaningCN: “还有晚上别把手机带上床，”我补充。

sentences.text: "Exactly right," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “完全正确，”她说。

sentences.text: The clock on the wall shows eight minutes past nine.
sentences.meaningCN: 墙上的钟显示九点零八分。

sentences.text: We take a short break with some quiet music.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们放着轻音乐短暂休息。

sentences.text: When we return, the phone lines are busy again.
sentences.meaningCN: 回来时，电话线路又忙了起来。

sentences.text: A listener from the south asks about weekend sleep.
sentences.meaningCN: 一位南方听众问起周末睡眠。

sentences.text: "Can we sleep late on Sunday morning?" she asks.
sentences.meaningCN: “周日早上能睡懒觉吗？”她问。

sentences.text: "A little, but not too much," says the doctor.
sentences.meaningCN: “可以一点，但别太久，”医生说。

sentences.text: "The body likes a regular rhythm, even at the weekend," she adds.
sentences.meaningCN: “身体喜欢规律的节奏，周末也一样，”她补充。

sentences.text: "That makes sense," the caller says.
sentences.meaningCN: “有道理，”来电者说。

sentences.text: Before we close the show, Dr. Park gives one last tip.
sentences.meaningCN: 在节目结束前，帕克博士给了最后一个建议。

sentences.text: "Put your phone in another room before you go to bed."
sentences.meaningCN: “睡前把手机放到另一个房间。”

sentences.text: "No way," I say again, and everyone in the studio laughs.
sentences.meaningCN: “不会吧，”我又说，演播室里的人都笑了。

sentences.text: The music fades and the studio lights go down.
sentences.meaningCN: 音乐渐弱，演播室的灯暗了下来。

sentences.text: We will be back tomorrow at the same time.
sentences.meaningCN: 我们明天同一时间再见。

articles.title: The Morning I Chose
articles.summaryCN: 换工作后的第一个早晨：早起、赶车、开会发言与被听见，写自我确认。

sentences.text: When the alarm rings at half past five, I get up before it can ring a second time.
sentences.meaningCN: 闹钟五点半响起，我没等它响第二遍就起床了。

sentences.text: The kitchen is still dark, and the coffee machine hums softly on the counter beside the window.
sentences.meaningCN: 厨房还黑着，咖啡机在窗边的台面上轻轻嗡鸣。

sentences.text: I am proud of how far I have come since I left my old job last winter.
sentences.meaningCN: 离开上一份工作以来的这段路，让我为自己骄傲。

sentences.text: Two months ago I was not sure whether this move would ever feel right.
sentences.meaningCN: 两个月前，我还不确定这次变动会不会真的合适。

sentences.text: This morning, standing by the window with a warm cup in my hands, I feel glad that I took the risk.
sentences.meaningCN: 今天早上，端着温热的杯子站在窗边，我庆幸自己冒了这个险。

sentences.text: The train is crowded, but I find a quiet corner and read the notes for my first meeting.
sentences.meaningCN: 车上很挤，但我找到一个安静的角落，读第一次会议的资料。

sentences.text: By the time I reach the office, the sun has climbed above the glass towers of the city center.
sentences.meaningCN: 等我到办公室时，太阳已经爬上市中心的玻璃高楼。

sentences.text: My new manager greets me at the door and shows me where to sit.
sentences.meaningCN: 新主管在门口跟我打招呼，带我找到座位。

sentences.text: "When you can, come by my desk and we will go through the plan for the week," she says.
sentences.meaningCN: “你方便的时候来我工位，我们一起过一下这周的计划，”她说。

sentences.text: I nod, take a deep breath, and open my laptop.
sentences.meaningCN: 我点点头，深吸一口气，打开电脑。

sentences.text: The first task is small, but it takes me much longer than I expected.
sentences.meaningCN: 第一项任务不大，却比我预想的花了更久。

sentences.text: Around ten, someone brings a tray of coffee and a box of biscuits from the shop downstairs.
sentences.meaningCN: 十点左右，有人端来一杯盘咖啡和楼下买的一盒饼干。

sentences.text: "Got it," I say when a colleague explains the shared folder and the naming rules.
sentences.meaningCN: 同事解释共享文件夹和命名规则时，我说“懂了”。

sentences.text: "Not at all," she replies when I thank her for the help.
sentences.meaningCN: 我谢她帮忙时，她说“没什么”。

sentences.text: At noon the team meets in a bright room with a long wooden table and a wide screen.
sentences.meaningCN: 中午，团队在一间明亮的长木桌会议室碰面，墙上有大屏幕。

sentences.text: "Yes I will," I answer when they ask who can handle the client call on Friday.
sentences.meaningCN: 他们问谁能负责周五的客户电话，我回答“我来”。

sentences.text: The discussion moves quickly, and I write down every decision we make.
sentences.meaningCN: 讨论进行得很快，我把每个决定都记下来。

sentences.text: By the end of the meeting, I feel relaxed enough to share my own idea about the schedule.
sentences.meaningCN: 会议快结束时，我放松下来，敢说出自己对排期的想法了。

sentences.text: Nobody laughs, and the manager writes my suggestion on the board next to hers.
sentences.meaningCN: 没有人笑，主管把我的建议写到她的想法旁边。

sentences.text: "I am fine with that plan," says the colleague beside me.
sentences.meaningCN: “这个方案我没问题，”身边的同事说。

sentences.text: After lunch, the office becomes quieter, and the afternoon light turns gold on the floor.
sentences.meaningCN: 午饭后办公室安静下来，午后的光在地板上变成金色。

sentences.text: I finish the client call, send the summary, and stretch my shoulders.
sentences.meaningCN: 我打完客户电话，发出纪要，伸展了一下肩膀。

sentences.text: On the way home I stop at a small park and sit on a bench for a while.
sentences.meaningCN: 回家路上，我在一个小公园停下，在长椅上坐了一会儿。

sentences.text: The city sounds different in the evening, softer and less demanding than in the morning.
sentences.meaningCN: 傍晚的城市听起来不一样，比早晨柔和，也没那么咄咄逼人。

sentences.text: I think about the morning, the meeting, and the small success of being heard.
sentences.meaningCN: 我想着那个早晨、那场会，还有“被听见”这件小小的成功。

sentences.text: Perhaps the hardest part of any new beginning is simply showing up.
sentences.meaningCN: 任何新的开始，最难的部分也许就是出现。

sentences.text: Tomorrow will bring new tasks, new names, and a few small mistakes.
sentences.meaningCN: 明天会带来新任务、新名字，还有几个小错误。

sentences.text: Tonight, however, I feel great about the way this day has gone.
sentences.meaningCN: 不过今晚，我对这一天的过法感觉很好。

sentences.text: I walk the last block home and unlock the door with a quiet smile.
sentences.meaningCN: 我走完最后一条街，带着安静的笑开门。

sentences.text: The coffee machine is still there, and the kitchen is still mine.
sentences.meaningCN: 咖啡机还在，厨房还是我的。
